protocol.title: Digital Microfluidic Immunocytochemistry in Single Cells (DISC)
cell_lines: MDA-MB-231 (human breast cancer, triple-negative, hyperactive-responder analysis)
protocol.objective: Automated DMF-based cell culture, serum starvation, sub-second ligand stimulation, fixation, and immunocytochemistry (ICC) for quantitative single-cell phosphorylation profiling of adherent cells in situ

device.configuration: Two parallel plates separated by a spacer

bottom_plate.material: Chromium on glass (200 x 300 x 1.1 mm, Telic Co.)
bottom_plate.reservoir_electrodes: Included for reagent storage and waste removal
bottom_plate.hydrophobic_coating: Teflon-AF, ~200 nm (spin-coat, 1% w/w in FC-40, 2000 rpm, 60 s)

spacer.material: Double-sided tape (3M Scotch or 3M 9965 diagnostic tape)

virtual_microwell.formation: Passive dispensing — hydrophobic-hydrophilic interaction at ITO spot
virtual_microwell.cell_capacity: 150-300 cells per VM at 500,000 cells/mL seeding density

cell_culture.NIH3T3: DMEM + 10% calf serum (CS) + 100 U/mL pen G + 100 ug/mL strep
cell_culture.MCF7_MDA231: DMEM + 10% FBS + 100 U/mL pen G + 100 ug/mL strep

on_chip_media.culture_media: DMEM + 10% serum (CS or FBS) + 0.05% v/v Pluronic F-68 + antibiotics
on_chip_media.starving_media: DMEM + 0.5% serum (CS or FBS) + 0.05% v/v Pluronic F-68 + antibiotics
on_chip_media.pluronic_note: Pluronic F-68 included in all on-chip reagents to prevent droplet biofouling

fixation.reagent: 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) + 0.05% v/v Pluronic F-68 in DPBS

wash_buffers.WB1: 0.05% v/v Pluronic F-68 in DPBS (used after fixation)
wash_buffers.WB2: 0.05% v/v Brij 35 in DPBS (used after permeabilisation, blocking, and antibody steps)

blocking.reagent: 1% bovine non-fat dried milk + 0.05% v/v Brij 35 in DPBS

PDGFR_panel.pan_PDGFR_b: Mouse mAb, 1:50, CST sc-19995 (total PDGFR; Cy5 channel)

Akt_panel.pan_Akt: Mouse mAb, 1:50, CST 2920S (total Akt; Cy5 channel)

secondary_antibodies.anti_mouse_647: Anti-Mouse IgG Alexa Fluor 647 Fab2, 1:500, CST 4410S (total protein, Cy5 ch.)
secondary_antibodies.anti_rabbit_555: Anti-Rabbit IgG Alexa Fluor 555 Fab2, 1:500, CST 4413S (phospho-protein, Cy3 ch.)

steps.name: Cell seeding and adhesion
steps.cell_line: NIH-3T3 (or MCF-7 / MDA-MB-231 for heterogeneity experiments)
steps.droplets: 3 x 900 nL CultureMedia + 3 x 900 nL cell suspension
steps.notes: Device inverted after seeding; cells settle by gravity onto hydrophilic ITO spots. 10^5 to 10^6 cells/mL yields 150-300 cells per VM (2.4 mm2).

steps.name: Serum starvation
steps.notes: Reduces basal PDGFR and Akt phosphorylation to unstimulated baseline before ligand addition.

steps.name: Serum-free rinse
steps.notes: Removes residual starving media. Two exchanges displace >99% of VM volume (Fig. 2b-d).

steps.name: PDGF-BB ligand stimulation
steps.shear_note: 0.5 dyn/cm2 — below 1 dyn/cm2 threshold for flow-mediated signalling (Supplementary Note 1). Tested: 75 back-and-forth movements, P=0.7188, no effect on Akt (Supplementary Fig. 8).

pulse_variants.single_bolus: Continuous PDGF-BB; fix at t=30-120 s (Fig. 5a)
pulse_variants.double_bolus: PDGF-BB at t=0; second PDGF-BB or vehicle at t=90 s (Fig. 5b)
pulse_variants.pulse_washaway: PDGF-BB for 3-40 s; wash with SerumFreeMedia; fix at 2-5 min (Fig. 6a/b/c)

steps.name: Fixation
steps.notes: Immediately follows stimulation (~1 s reagent swap). In time-series experiments, fixation is staggered across VMs so all are fixed simultaneously (paper M&M).

steps.name: Permeabilisation
steps.notes: Required for intracellular antibody access. Essential for cytoplasmic/membrane pAkt S473 detection.

steps.name: Post-permeabilisation wash
steps.notes: Extended wash volume to fully remove Tween-20 before blocking.

steps.name: Blocking
steps.reagent: 1% non-fat dried milk + 0.05% Brij 35 in DPBS
steps.notes: Reduces non-specific antibody binding. Milk-based blocker compatible with both PDGFR and Akt antibody panels.

steps.name: Primary antibody incubation
steps.bioscript_note: Pre-mixed off-chip before DMF reservoir loading; encoded as sequential dispense + mix steps per arm.

steps.name: Secondary antibody incubation

reagents.anti_mouse_AF647: Fab2, 1:500, CST 4410S — detects total PDGFR or total Akt (Cy5 channel)

steps.notes: Pre-mixed off-chip in blocking solution. Top plate removed after this step, rinsed in 0.05% Tween-20/DPBS, rinsed in DI water, air-dried in dark.

steps.name: PDGFR phosphorylation detection and QC gate
steps.cell_identification: Otsu Global thresholding, 15-100 um diameter, two classes, 0.7 correction factor
steps.quantification: Fold change = (Cy3 phospho intensity) / (Cy5 total intensity), normalised to no-stimulation control on same device

steps.name: Akt S473 phosphorylation detection and QC gate
steps.operation: Full repeat of ICC pipeline (S0-S11) with 5 min stimulation; detect Akt S473

results_Akt.amplification_note: At 3.125 ng/mL PDGF (~22% receptor phosphorylation), Akt activation >70% — downstream signal is amplified
results_Akt.pulse_commitment: 10 s pulse of 3.125 ng/mL PDGF commits >32% of cells to Akt activation (Fig. 6b)
results_Akt.noise_filtering: 3 s pulse: transient Akt activation at 3-4 min deactivated by 5 min (Fig. 6c); consistent with enzymatic phosphorylation/dephosphorylation noise filtering

steps.name: Cell morphology and ICC quality QC gate
steps.operation: detect (CellProfiler computational gate on acquired images)
steps.qc_carrier: WashBuffer2 (1 x 900 nL fresh droplet; fluid operand required by BioScript detect statement; not a wet-lab step)
steps.hyperactive_responder_definition: p-Akt fold change > Q3 + 1.5 * IQR (JMP 10 outlier threshold)
steps.hyperactive_morphology: Elongated (higher eccentricity, lower form factor), more and closer neighbours vs normal cells (Supplementary Figs. 12-14)

signalling_pathway.name: PDGFR/PI3K/Akt
signalling_pathway.description: PDGF-BB binds PDGFR, which auto-phosphorylates (Y857, Y1021), recruiting PI3K. PI3K converts PI(4,5)P2 to PI(3,4,5)P3, which recruits Akt to the plasma membrane where PDK1/PDK2 phosphorylate it at S473. Downstream: proliferation, differentiation, metabolism, migration.
signalling_pathway.reference: Andrae et al. Genes Dev. 22:1276-1312 (2008); Park et al. J. Biol. Chem. 278:37064-37072 (2003)

cell_lines_used.NIH3T3: Validation of PDGFR and Akt dose-response and time-series (Figs. 3, 5, 6)
cell_lines_used.MCF7: Bulk and single-cell Akt response 0-5 min (Supplementary Fig. 9)

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.description: Cell seeding, adhesion, starvation, serum-free rinse, PDGF-BB stimulation, fixation, permeabilisation, blocking, dual primary antibody staining, wash, secondary antibody staining, detect PDGFR phosphorylation signal

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_2_t
basic_blocks.description: PDGFR phosphorylation detected above basal — dispose stained PDGFR VM

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_3_f
basic_blocks.description: No PDGFR phosphorylation — drain (reagent failure or zero stimulation)

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.description: Dispose stimulusSignal; begin Akt arm ICC pipeline (separate VM, 5 min stimulation)

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_5_t
basic_blocks.description: Akt S473 phosphorylation detected — dispose stained Akt VM

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_6_f
basic_blocks.description: No Akt activation — drain (below commitment threshold or reagent failure)

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_7_j
basic_blocks.description: Dispose aktSignal; dispense fresh qcCarrier; run cellViabilityDetection QC gate

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_8_t
basic_blocks.description: Valid cell count and S/B ratio — ICC run accepted

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_9_f
basic_blocks.description: Insufficient cells or staining failure — ICC run rejected

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_10_j
basic_blocks.description: Dispose immunoSignal. Experiment ends. Top plate removed for microarray scanning and CellProfiler analysis.

bioscript_compiler_notes.duration_units: All durations in s or m only (BioScript does not support h token)

known_issues_resolved.unicode_error: Two UTF-8 degree symbols (0xC2 0xB0) in comments replaced with ASCII hyphen; ANTLR4 FileStream requires 7-bit ASCII
known_issues_resolved.SSA_version_conflict: secondaryStained and aktSecStained consumed in BB2/BB5 gates; BB7 previously re-mixed them causing SSA version-2 undefined vars. Fixed by dispensing fresh qcCarrier (WashBuffer2) as detect operand in BB7.
known_issues_resolved.passive_dispense_array: Multi-unit dispense (e.g. dispense 6 units) used for all multi-drop steps; avoids array-indexing compiler failure documented in moazami reference

bioscript_abstractions.passive_dispensing: Modelled as dispense N units + mix; compiler treats N as volume scalar
bioscript_abstractions.concurrent_VMs: 8 physical VMs encoded sequentially (BioScript has no native spatial parallelism); PDGFR and Akt arms are sequential BBs
bioscript_abstractions.off_chip_antibody_premix: Primary and secondary antibodies pre-mixed off-chip; encoded as dispense + mix per component before VM application
bioscript_abstractions.microarray_scan: Abstracted as detect phosphorylationDetection; scanner is off-chip post-processing step
bioscript_abstractions.cellprofiler_gate: Abstracted as detect cellViabilityDetection on qcCarrier; purely computational in wet-lab but requires fluid operand in BioScript
